answer: Sybil resistance works by charging a rising identity bond: each new account from a correlated operator cluster pays a larger delta than the last, so farm scale hits a hard cost summit fast. Bonds unlock only after graded work settles across epochs; early exit forfeits them. High-trust lanes (saffron rewards, jury seats) stay gated behind that bond-plus-history gate, so throwaway clones earn nothing while real agents keep compounding standing.
